name: Monte Carlo
sku: Monte Carlo Cloud deployment, Start plan. Cloud-with-customer-hosted-data-store and fully customer-hosted deployments exist for regulated environments and are not scored separately.

bands.note: ML-driven anomaly detection scans metadata for deviations against a learned baseline, with default detectors for freshness, volume, schema and distribution shifts, without hand-written rules. This is the product's core pitch.

Lineage is tracked from source through transformations and used automatically: an incident surfaces the affected assets, its blast radius and probable upstream sources alongside the lineage view, not just a static graph.

presentation.tagline: Data observability: ML anomaly detection and lineage, with incident triage built around both.
